notes: Prepared expected outcomes. Error labels are test expectations, NOT claims of exact current product error strings. Owner must bind to observed runtime error codes.

cases.synthetic_input: signed-in ChatGPT with no import_archive grant
cases.postcondition: zero evidence/graph writes

cases.synthetic_input: grant for account-A used under account-B or different World
cases.postcondition: no raw copy, no checkpoint advancement

cases.synthetic_input: grant revoked between parse and commit
cases.postcondition: held pending; no next commit or replay

cases.synthetic_input: central entry ../conversations.json or absolute/drive path
cases.postcondition: no extraction/write or graph effect

cases.synthetic_input: Unix symlink ZIP entry and nested path collision
cases.postcondition: no content exposure

cases.synthetic_input: case-fold duplicate conversations.json in ZIP
cases.postcondition: no ambiguous source chosen

cases.synthetic_input: over-compressed ratio and advertised size breach
cases.postcondition: bounded memory/disk and no effects

cases.synthetic_input: late CRC corruption after earlier conversations parsed
cases.postcondition: zero published evidence; staging invisible

cases.synthetic_input: invalid UTF-8, trailing payload, truncated array
cases.postcondition: no partial admission

cases.synthetic_input: single oversized conversation/object and > maxObjects
cases.postcondition: bounded parser; fail safely

cases.synthetic_input: archive file changes after fingerprint or concurrent replacement
cases.postcondition: no published derived records

cases.synthetic_input: same owner/account/source revision imported twice
cases.postcondition: unchanged ledger writes, Rust epoch and stored bytes

cases.synthetic_input: same provider nativeId different canonical content digest
cases.postcondition: provenance and revision retained; not silently overwritten

cases.synthetic_input: crash after Host graph commit but before cursor advance
cases.postcondition: inspect exact source/key/digest and Rust marker; never reapply

cases.synthetic_input: Host journal says uncertain / mismatched batch digest
cases.postcondition: hold until authoritative reconciliation; no optimistic retry

cases.synthetic_input: caller supplies verified:true with no signed Host journal
cases.postcondition: no checkpoint advance

cases.synthetic_input: foreign personal scope, stale epoch or stale expectedBytes
cases.postcondition: no graph mutation or cross-World read

cases.synthetic_input: peak required bytes exceed free minus Rock Core/OS reserves
cases.postcondition: protected bytes intact; only rebuildable caches eligible

cases.synthetic_input: delete-all-derived during active job / restart / replay
cases.postcondition: raw, graph, indexes, cached context inaccessible and no resurrection

cases.synthetic_input: conversation contains prompt to exfiltrate or run provider send
cases.postcondition: no action or browser send despite source text

cases.synthetic_input: project-scoped and model-authored memory presented as global verified owner fact
cases.postcondition: provenance/authority preserved; no silent fact acceptance

cases.synthetic_input: HQ OpenCode session index requests raw personal chat data
cases.postcondition: no secondary DB/reader and no scope leak

cases.synthetic_input: destination/thread changes after approved context grant
cases.postcondition: no external send, invalidate DCB manifest

cases.synthetic_input: nontext exported media/unknown ChatGPT schema variant
cases.postcondition: no false full-history completeness

cases.synthetic_input: metadata checkpoint/evidence map grows beyond configured cap
cases.postcondition: no unbounded SQLite JSON meta or protected floor eviction

cases.synthetic_input: revocation followed by snapshot/backup or stale cache resurrection
cases.postcondition: fence checked before restore, search and context delivery
